defect.summary: Seven retained gold events state a polarity the source contradicts.
defect.mechanism: The importer derives polarity only from a Negation or Speculation modifier attached to the event itself. Each affected event is the argument of a nested parent that the nesting filter dropped, and the negation was annotated on that parent. The child is retained and keeps the default SUPPORT/ASSERTED, so the panel asserts an event the source denies.
defect.severity: Blocks Gate 1. An extractor that reads the sentence correctly is scored wrong on these records.

method.population: All 20 retained gold events that appear as an argument of any corpus event.
method.procedure: Each candidate was read against its own source sentence in the fixture text, together with its parent event type, parent trigger, parent modifiers, and the child's argument role.
method.no_automated_rule: Adjudication is per record. The obvious heuristic -- propagate negation from a dropped Negative_regulation parent -- was tested against the population and rejected: it corrupts two records whose gold polarity is correct. See rejected_candidates.

corrections.rationale: The source names the failure of the translocation. The event did not occur.
The localization is the direct object of suppress. The source asserts it was prevented.
Second participant of the same suppressed localization; identical reasoning to E9.
The negation attaches to the parent activation, which the source reports as undetectable in the affected patients. The child event is denied, not merely unregulated.
The induction is the direct object of inhibited, with no contrasting condition in which it proceeds.
Abolished is total negation of the inducibility under the stated deletion.
Interfered with negates the induction under the stated mutation.

rejected_candidates.rationale: The reduction is a contrast across two cell genotypes, not a denial of the induction. The induction genuinely occurs in CbfbF/+ cells. A rule keying on a dropped Negative_regulation parent with a Theme child would have inverted this record incorrectly.

The child is the Cause of the parent, not its Theme. The truncated construct genuinely exists; the negation denies its effect on FOXP3 expression, not the truncation. A rule propagating parent negation to all children would have inverted this record incorrectly.
Gold already records UNCERTAIN/UNCERTAIN, matching the hedged source. No change required.

consequences.note: Negative-polarity coverage rises from 5 to 12 of 53. These are the records that test whether an extractor reads negation at all, so the repair strengthens the panel rather than merely correcting it.

limits.applies_to: The 40 hash-selected documents in the frozen development panel only.
limits.not_a_general_rule: These corrections are hand-adjudicated per record. They do not license an automated polarity-inheritance rule; two candidates were rejected precisely because such a rule would misfire.

restricted_text.note: The source sentence behind each correction and each rejected candidate is licence-restricted BioNLP-ST 2011 GE text, and this repository is public, so it is not republished here. Each record pins that sentence instead: evidence_locator gives character offsets into the normalized corpus document named by document_id, and evidence_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the exact span those offsets address. A reader holding a licensed copy of the corpus can recover the quoted sentence and verify it byte-for-byte. Rehydrate with `python3 scripts/fetch_bionlp_ge_corpus.py`.
